description: Reproducible bytes with a dated footer (generate_basic_pdf v1.7.0 on pdfnative 1.8): every date is written in UTC (`+00'00'`), so pinning `creationDate` makes the output byte-identical across calls AND across hosts, whatever the server's time zone. The `{date}` placeholder follows `creationDate` — here it prints 2026-01-01 — so a dated footer no longer breaks reproducibility. Call it twice and compare the bytes. Operators can pin the instant for the whole server instead (PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE, else SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH); a call's own `creationDate` still wins. Not covered by any pin: signatures' signingTime, update_metadata's modDate, RFC 3161 timestamps, encryption. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.

blocks.text: The same inputs produce the same file on every machine.
